content.comment_body: I'm unable to see any details in the info window; it remains blank. Previously, when I used [product_name] V3, the info window functioned correctly. After upgrading from version 4 to [version_no], the issue persists and was not resolved.
There are no known issues with the Info window in [product_name] V4. For example, pressing F2 shows program comments in the Info window for me.

analysis.insight_summary: A user describes that after updating to [product_name] [version_no], the Info window fails to display any information, whereas it worked in an earlier version. Another user notes that they have not encountered this issue in version 4, indicating that the problem may not be universal to all users or setups.
